ledger: Car (cream/wood-grain wagon) | front-left 3/4 view, grille fully visible, camera wide | side close-up, hood and window dominate frame | camera continuously orbits front-to-side; vehicle shows no forward slip relative to ground, consistent with steady drive

Background (desert, road, utility poles) | open desert with road edge on left | road with yellow dashes and poles, motion-blurred | background flows continuously backward past the car in a direction matching forward motion; no jumps or reversals

Woman's hair | mostly settled, slight lift | strongly blown up and toward car rear (frame right) | displacement ramps smoothly from frames ~5-9, magnitude tracks with visible motion/wind, no sudden onset

Sun glare / lens flare | absent (front-facing light) | bright flare sweeping across windshield and rim-lighting hair | flare enters and intensifies only as camera angle relative to sun rotates; cause (camera orbit) precedes the brightening
Woman's arms | crossed, resting on open door frame | crossed, resting on open door frame | position constant; no unexplained repositioning
Front antenna | thin vertical rod | thin vertical rod | stays upright through motion; no snap or lag
